name: nsSub_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀r env1 env2.
    nsSub r env1 env2 ⇔
    (∀id v1. nsLookup env1 id = SOME v1 ⇒ ∃v2. nsLookup env2 id = SOME v2 ∧ r id v1 v2) ∧
    ∀path. nsLookupMod env2 path = NONE ⇒ nsLookupMod env1 path = NONE

name: nsSing_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x. nsSing n x = Bind [(n,x)] []

name: nsOptBind_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x env. nsOptBind n x env = case n of NONE => env | SOME n => nsBind n x env

name: nsOpen_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀path env. nsOpen path env = if NULL path then NONE else nsLookupMod env path

name: nsMap_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P. (∀f v m. (∀mn e. MEM (mn,e) m ⇒ P f e) ⇒ P f (Bind v m)) ⇒ ∀v v1. P v v1

name: nsMap_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀v m f. nsMap f (Bind v m) = Bind (MAP (λ(n,x). (n,f x)) v) (MAP (λ(mn,e). (mn,nsMap f e)) m)

name: nsLookupMod_ind
pretty:
⊢ ∀P. (∀e. P e []) ∧ (∀v m mn path. (∀env. ALOOKUP m mn = SOME env ⇒ P env path) ⇒ P (Bind v m) (mn::path)) ⇒
      ∀v v1. P v v1

name: nsLookupMod_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀e. nsLookupMod e [] = SOME e) ∧
  ∀v path mn m. nsLookupMod (Bind v m) (mn::path) = case ALOOKUP m mn of NONE => NONE | SOME env => nsLookupMod env path

name: nsLookup_ind
pretty:
⊢ ∀P. (∀v m n. P (Bind v m) (Short n)) ∧
      (∀v m mn id. (∀env. ALOOKUP m mn = SOME env ⇒ P env id) ⇒ P (Bind v m) (Long mn id)) ⇒
      ∀v v1. P v v1

name: nsLookup_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀v n m. nsLookup (Bind v m) (Short n) = ALOOKUP v n) ∧
  ∀v mn m id. nsLookup (Bind v m) (Long mn id) = case ALOOKUP m mn of NONE => NONE | SOME env => nsLookup env id

name: nsLift_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn env. nsLift mn env = Bind [] [(mn,env)]

name: nsEmpty_def
pretty: ⊢ nsEmpty = Bind [] []

name: nsDomMod_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀env. nsDomMod env = {n | (v,n) | v ∈ 𝕌(:(ν, ξ, φ) namespace) ∧ n ∈ 𝕌(:ν list) ∧ nsLookupMod env n = SOME v}

name: nsDom_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀env. nsDom env = {n | (v,n) | v ∈ 𝕌(:φ) ∧ n ∈ 𝕌(:(ν, ξ) id) ∧ nsLookup env n = SOME v}

name: nsBindList_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀l e. nsBindList l e = FOLDR (λ(x,v) e. nsBind x v e) e l

name: nsBind_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀k x v m. nsBind k x (Bind v m) = Bind ((k,x)::v) m

name: nsAppend_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P. (∀v1 m1 v2 m2. P (Bind v1 m1) (Bind v2 m2)) ⇒ ∀v v1. P v v1

name: nsAppend_def
pretty: ⊢ nsAppend (Bind v1 m1) (Bind v2 m2) = Bind (v1 ++ v2) (m1 ++ m2)

name: nsAll_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀f env. nsAll f env ⇔ ∀id v. nsLookup env id = SOME v ⇒ f id v

name: nsAll2_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀r env1 env2. nsAll2 r env1 env2 ⇔ nsSub r env1 env2 ∧ nsSub (λx y z. r x z y) env2 env1

name: namespaceSET3_thm
pretty:
⊢ namespaceSET3 (Bind a0 a1) =
  BIGUNION (IMAGE setSND (set a0)) ∪ BIGUNION (IMAGE namespaceSET3 (BIGUNION (IMAGE setSND (set a1))))

name: namespaceSET3_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P'. (∀l. (∀n p. n ∈ setSND p ∧ MEM p l ⇒ P' n) ⇒ ∀l0. P' (Bind l0 l)) ⇒ ∀n. P' n

name: namespaceSET3_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀af.
    namespaceSET3 (namespace_CONS af) =
    S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG $= ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setFST)
      (BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setSND) af ∪
    BIGUNION
      (IMAGE namespaceSET3
         (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setFST)
            (BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG $= ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setSND) af))

name: namespaceSET2_thm
pretty:
⊢ namespaceSET2 (Bind a0 a1) =

name: namespaceSET2_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P'. (∀l. (∀n p. n ∈ setSND p ∧ MEM p l ⇒ P' n) ⇒ ∀l0. P' (Bind l0 l)) ⇒ ∀n. P' n

name: namespaceSET2_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀af.
    namespaceSET2 (namespace_CONS af) =
    S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG $= ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setFST)
      (BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setSND) af ∪
    BIGUNION

            (BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG $= ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setSND) af))

name: namespaceSET1_thm
pretty:
⊢ namespaceSET1 (Bind a0 a1) =
  BIGUNION (IMAGE setFST (set a1)) ∪ BIGUNION (IMAGE namespaceSET1 (BIGUNION (IMAGE setSND (set a1))))

name: namespaceSET1_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P'. (∀l. (∀n p. n ∈ setSND p ∧ MEM p l ⇒ P' n) ⇒ ∀l0. P' (Bind l0 l)) ⇒ ∀n. P' n

name: namespaceSET1_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀af.
    namespaceSET1 (namespace_CONS af) =
    S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setFST)
      (BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG $= ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setSND) af ∪
    BIGUNION
      (IMAGE namespaceSET1

            (BIMG (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG $= ∘ setSND)) ∘ set) ∘ setSND) af))

name: namespaceREL_def
pretty:
⊢ namespaceREL =
  (λR1 R2 R3 x y.
     ∃z. (∀p. p ∈ namespaceSET1 z ⇒ R1 (FST p) (SND p)) ∧ (∀p. p ∈ namespaceSET2 z ⇒ R2 (FST p) (SND p)) ∧
         (∀p. p ∈ namespaceSET3 z ⇒ R3 (FST p) (SND p)) ∧ namespaceMAP FST FST FST z = x ∧
         namespaceMAP SND SND SND z = y)

name: namespaceMAP_thm
pretty: ⊢ namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3 (Bind a0 a1) = Bind (MAP (f2 ## f3) a0) (MAP (f1 ## namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3) a1)

name: namespaceMAP_ind
pretty:
⊢ ∀P'.
    (∀f f' f'' l. (∀n p. n ∈ setSND p ∧ MEM p l ⇒ P' f f' f'' n) ⇒ ∀l0. P' f f' f'' (Bind l0 l)) ⇒
    ∀f f' f'' n. P' f f' f'' n

name: namespaceMAP_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀f1 f2 f3 af.
    namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3 (namespace_CONS af) =
    namespace_CONS ((MAP (f2 ## f3) ## MAP (f1 ## namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3)) af)

name: namespace_wit
pretty:
⊢ ∀a1 a2 a3.
    namespaceSET1 ((λa1 a2 a3. namespace_CONS (list_CONS ((K ∘ INL) ARB ARB),list_CONS ((K ∘ INL) ARB ARB))) a1 a2 a3) ⊆
    ∅ ∧
    namespaceSET2 ((λa1 a2 a3. namespace_CONS (list_CONS ((K ∘ INL) ARB ARB),list_CONS ((K ∘ INL) ARB ARB))) a1 a2 a3) ⊆
    ∅ ∧
    namespaceSET3 ((λa1 a2 a3. namespace_CONS (list_CONS ((K ∘ INL) ARB ARB),list_CONS ((K ∘ INL) ARB ARB))) a1 a2 a3) ⊆
    ∅

name: namespace_size_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀f0 f1 f2 a0 a1.
    namespace_size f0 f1 f2 (Bind a0 a1) =
    1 + (list_size (pair_size f1 f2) a0 + list_size (pair_size f0 (namespace_size f0 f1 f2)) a1)

name: namespace_nchotomy
pretty: ⊢ ∀nn. ∃l0 l. nn = Bind l0 l

name: namespace_MAP_O
pretty: ⊢ namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3 ∘ namespaceMAP g1 g2 g3 = namespaceMAP (f1 ∘ g1) (f2 ∘ g2) (f3 ∘ g3)

name: namespace_MAP_IMAGE3
pretty: ⊢ ∀f1 f2 f3 n. namespaceSET3 (namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3 n) = IMAGE f3 (namespaceSET3 n)

name: namespace_MAP_IMAGE2
pretty: ⊢ ∀f1 f2 f3 n. namespaceSET2 (namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3 n) = IMAGE f2 (namespaceSET2 n)

name: namespace_MAP_IMAGE1

name: namespace_MAP_ID
pretty: ⊢ namespaceMAP I I I = I

name: namespace_MAP_CONG
pretty:
⊢ ∀f1 f2 f3 g1 g2 g3 x.

    (∀a. a ∈ namespaceSET3 x ⇒ f3 a = g3 a) ⇒
    namespaceMAP f1 f2 f3 x = namespaceMAP g1 g2 g3 x

name: namespace_inh3
pretty: ⊢ ∀a4. a4 ∈ namespaceSET3 ((λa4. namespace_CONS (flip $, ARB (list_CONS (INR (flip $, ARB (ARB,a4)))))) a4)

name: namespace_inh2
pretty: ⊢ ∀a3. a3 ∈ namespaceSET2 ((λa3. namespace_CONS (flip $, ARB (list_CONS (INR (flip $, ARB (flip $, ARB a3)))))) a3)

name: namespace_inh1
pretty: ⊢ ∀a2. a2 ∈ namespaceSET1 ((λa2. namespace_CONS (ARB,list_CONS (INR (flip $, ARB (flip $, ARB a2))))) a2)

name: namespace_induction
pretty: ⊢ ∀P. (∀l. (∀n p. n ∈ setSND p ∧ MEM p l ⇒ P n) ⇒ ∀l0. P (Bind l0 l)) ⇒ ∀n. P n

name: namespace_case_eq
pretty: ⊢ namespace_CASE x f = v ⇔ ∃l0 l. x = Bind l0 l ∧ f l0 l = v

name: namespace_case_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀a0 a1 f. namespace_CASE (Bind a0 a1) f = f a0 a1

name: namespace_case_cong
pretty: ⊢ ∀M M' f. M = M' ∧ (∀a0 a1. M' = Bind a0 a1 ⇒ f a0 a1 = f' a0 a1) ⇒ namespace_CASE M f = namespace_CASE M' f'

name: namespace_bnd2
pretty: ⊢ ∀n. cardleq (namespaceSET2 n) 𝕌(:num)

name: namespace_bnd1
pretty: ⊢ ∀n. cardleq (namespaceSET1 n) 𝕌(:num)

name: namespace_Axiom
pretty: ⊢ ∀f0. ∃h. ∀a0 a1. h (Bind a0 a1) = f0 a0 a1 (MAP (I ## h) a1)

name: namespace_11
pretty: ⊢ ∀a0 a1 a0' a1'. Bind a0 a1 = Bind a0' a1' ⇔ a0 = a0' ∧ a1 = a1'

name: mk_id_def
pretty: ⊢ (∀n. mk_id [] n = Short n) ∧ ∀mn mns n. mk_id (mn::mns) n = Long mn (mk_id mns n)

pretty: ⊢ idSET2 (Short a0) = {a0} ∧ idSET2 (Long a0 a1) = idSET2 a1

name: idSET2_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P'. (∀n. P' (Short n)) ∧ (∀i. P' i ⇒ ∀m. P' (Long m i)) ⇒ ∀i. P' i

name: idSET2_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀af.
    idSET2 (id_CONS af) =
    S ($UNION ∘ BIMG $= ∘ setL) (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ setR) af ∪
    BIGUNION
      (IMAGE idSET2
         (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setL) (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setFST) (BIMG $= ∘ setSND)) ∘ setR) af))

name: idSET1_thm
pretty: ⊢ idSET1 (Short a0) = ∅ ∧ idSET1 (Long a0 a1) = a0 INSERT idSET1 a1

name: idSET1_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P'. (∀n. P' (Short n)) ∧ (∀i. P' i ⇒ ∀m. P' (Long m i)) ⇒ ∀i. P' i

name: idSET1_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀af.
    idSET1 (id_CONS af) =
    S ($UNION ∘ BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setL) (BIMG (S ($UNION ∘ BIMG $= ∘ setFST) (BIMG (K ∅) ∘ setSND)) ∘ setR) af ∪

name: idREL_def

name: idMAP_thm
pretty: ⊢ idMAP f1 f2 (Short a0) = Short (f2 a0) ∧ idMAP f1 f2 (Long a0 a1) = Long (f1 a0) (idMAP f1 f2 a1)

name: idMAP_ind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P'. (∀f f'. (∀n. P' f f' (Short n)) ∧ ∀i. P' f f' i ⇒ ∀m. P' f f' (Long m i)) ⇒ ∀f f' i. P' f f' i

name: idMAP_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀f1 f2 af. idMAP f1 f2 (id_CONS af) = id_CONS (SUM_MAP f2 (f1 ## idMAP f1 f2) af)

name: id_wit

⊢ ∀a1 a2.

name: id_to_n_def
pretty: ⊢ (∀n. id_to_n (Short n) = n) ∧ ∀v0 id. id_to_n (Long v0 id) = id_to_n id

name: id_to_mods_def

name: id_size_MAP
pretty: ⊢ ∀f1 f2 x. id_size (λx. x) (λx. x) (idMAP f1 f2 x) = id_size f1 f2 x

name: id_size_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀f0 f1 a0. id_size f0 f1 (Short a0) = 1 + f1 a0) ∧
  ∀f0 f1 a0 a1. id_size f0 f1 (Long a0 a1) = 1 + (f0 a0 + id_size f0 f1 a1)

name: id_nchotomy
pretty: ⊢ ∀ii. (∃n. ii = Short n) ∨ ∃m i. ii = Long m i

name: id_MAP_O
pretty: ⊢ idMAP f1 f2 ∘ idMAP g1 g2 = idMAP (f1 ∘ g1) (f2 ∘ g2)

name: id_MAP_IMAGE2
pretty: ⊢ ∀f1 f2 n. idSET2 (idMAP f1 f2 n) = IMAGE f2 (idSET2 n)

name: id_MAP_IMAGE1

name: id_MAP_ID

name: id_MAP_CONG
pretty: ⊢ ∀f1 f2 g1 g2 x. (∀a. a ∈ idSET1 x ⇒ f1 a = g1 a) ∧ (∀a. a ∈ idSET2 x ⇒ f2 a = g2 a) ⇒ idMAP f1 f2 x = idMAP g1 g2 x

name: id_inh2

name: id_inh1

name: id_induction

name: id_case_eq
pretty: ⊢ id_CASE x f f0 = v ⇔ (∃n. x = Short n ∧ f n = v) ∨ ∃m i. x = Long m i ∧ f0 m i = v

name: id_case_def

name: id_case_cong

name: id_bnd1

name: id_11

name: datatype_namespace

name: datatype_id

name: alist_to_ns_def

name: nsSub_refl
pretty: ⊢ ∀P R. (∀n x. P n x ⇒ R n x x) ⇒ ∀e. nsAll P e ⇒ nsSub R e e

name: nsSub_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀R f n1 n2. nsSub R (nsMap f n1) (nsMap f n2) ⇔ nsSub (λid x y. R id (f x) (f y)) n1 n2

name: nsSub_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀r env. nsSub r nsEmpty env

name: nsSub_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀R x v1 v2 e1 e2. R (Short x) v1 v2 ∧ nsSub R e1 e2 ⇒ nsSub R (nsBind x v1 e1) (nsBind x v2 e2)

name: nsSub_nsAppend_lift
pretty:
⊢ ∀R mn e1 e1' e2 e2'.
    nsSub (λid. R (Long mn id)) e1 e1' ∧ nsSub R e2 e2' ⇒

name: nsSub_nsAppend2
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e2 e2'. nsSub R e1 e1 ∧ nsSub R e2 e2' ⇒ nsSub R (nsAppend e1 e2) (nsAppend e1 e2')

name: nsSub_mono2
pretty: ⊢ (∀x y z. nsLookup e1 x = SOME y ∧ nsLookup e2 x = SOME z ∧ R1 x y z ⇒ R2 x y z) ⇒ nsSub R1 e1 e2 ⇒ nsSub R2 e1 e2

name: nsSub_mono
pretty: ⊢ (∀x y z. R1 x y z ⇒ R2 x y z) ⇒ nsSub R1 e1 e2 ⇒ nsSub R2 e1 e2

name: nsSub_conj
pretty: ⊢ ∀P Q e1 e2. nsSub (λid x y. P id x y ∧ Q id x y) e1 e2 ⇔ nsSub P e1 e2 ∧ nsSub Q e1 e2

name: nsSub_compute_ind
pretty:
⊢ ∀P. (∀path R e1V e1M e2V e2M.
         (∀k v1 v2. ALOOKUP e1M k = SOME v1 ∧ ALOOKUP e2M k = SOME v2 ⇒ P (k::path) R v1 v2) ⇒
         P path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M)) ⇒

name: nsSub_compute_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀path e2V e2M e1V e1M R.

    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧

name: nsOpen_eq_some

pretty: ⊢ ∀f l. nsMap f (alist_to_ns l) = alist_to_ns (MAP (λ(k,v). (k,f v)) l)

name: nsLookupMod_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2 v. nsLookupMod (nsSing n2 v) n1 = if n1 = [] then SOME (nsSing n2 v) else NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x f. nsLookupMod (nsMap f n) x = OPTION_MAP (nsMap f) (nsLookupMod n x)

name: nsLookupMod_nsLift
pretty:
⊢ ∀mn e path.
    nsLookupMod (nsLift mn e) path =
    case path of [] => SOME (nsLift mn e) | mn'::path' => if mn = mn' then nsLookupMod e path' else NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsLookupMod nsEmpty (x::y) = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsAppend_some
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 e2 path.
    nsLookupMod (nsAppend e1 e2) path = SOME x ⇔
    if path = [] then x = nsAppend e1 e2
    else
      nsLookupMod e1 path = SOME x ∨
      nsLookupMod e2 path = SOME x ∧ ∀p1 p2. p1 ≠ [] ∧ path = p1 ++ p2 ⇒ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsAppend_none
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 e2 path.
    nsLookupMod (nsAppend e1 e2) path = NONE ⇔
    nsLookupMod e1 path = NONE ∧
    (nsLookupMod e2 path = NONE ∨ ∃p1 p2 e3. p1 ≠ [] ∧ path = p1 ++ p2 ∧ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = SOME e3)

name: nsLookupMod_FOLDR_nsLift_none
pretty: ⊢ ∀e p1 p2. nsLookupMod (FOLDR nsLift e p1) p2 = NONE ⇔ p2 ≼ p1 ∨ p1 ≼ p2 ⇒ ∃p3. p2 = p1 ++ p3 ∧ nsLookupMod e p3 = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_append
pretty:
⊢ nsLookupMod env (path ++ suffix) =
  case nsLookupMod env path of NONE => NONE | SOME opened => nsLookupMod opened suffix

name: nsLookupMod_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀l x y. nsLookupMod (alist_to_ns l) (x::y) = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_after_nsOpen
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path env = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookupMod opened suffix = nsLookupMod env (path ++ suffix)

name: nsLookupMod_after_nsLookupMod
pretty: ⊢ nsLookupMod env path = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookupMod opened suffix = nsLookupMod env (path ++ suffix)

name: nsLookup_to_nsLookupMod
pretty: ⊢ ∀n v t. nsLookup n v = SOME t ⇒ ∃m. nsLookupMod n (id_to_mods v) = SOME m ∧ nsLookup m (Short (id_to_n v)) = SOME t

name: nsLookup_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀n v id. nsLookup (nsSing n v) id = if id = Short n then SOME v else NONE

name: nsLookup_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x f. nsLookup (nsMap f n) x = OPTION_MAP f (nsLookup n x)

name: nsLookup_nsLift_append
pretty:
⊢ ∀m ns ns' m' id n.
    nsLookup (nsAppend (nsLift m ns) ns') (Short n) = nsLookup ns' (Short n) ∧
    nsLookup (nsAppend (nsLift m ns) ns') (Long m' id) = if m = m' then nsLookup ns id else nsLookup ns' (Long m' id)

name: nsLookup_nsLift
pretty:
⊢ ∀mn e id.
    nsLookup (nsLift mn e) id = case id of Short v => NONE | Long mn' id' => if mn = mn' then nsLookup e id' else NONE

name: nsLookup_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀id. nsLookup nsEmpty id = NONE

name: nsLookup_nsDom
pretty: ⊢ ∀x n. x ∈ nsDom n ⇔ ∃v. nsLookup n x = SOME v

name: nsLookup_nsBind
pretty:
⊢ (∀n v e. nsLookup (nsBind n v e) (Short n) = SOME v) ∧
  ∀n n' v e. n ≠ Short n' ⇒ nsLookup (nsBind n' v e) n = nsLookup e n

name: nsLookup_nsAppend_some
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 id e2 v.
    nsLookup (nsAppend e1 e2) id = SOME v ⇔
    nsLookup e1 id = SOME v ∨
    nsLookup e1 id = NONE ∧ nsLookup e2 id = SOME v ∧
    ∀p1 p2. p1 ≠ [] ∧ id_to_mods id = p1 ++ p2 ⇒ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = NONE

name: nsLookup_nsAppend_none
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 id e2.
    nsLookup (nsAppend e1 e2) id = NONE ⇔
    nsLookup e1 id = NONE ∧
    (nsLookup e2 id = NONE ∨ ∃p1 p2 e3. p1 ≠ [] ∧ id_to_mods id = p1 ++ p2 ∧ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = SOME e3)

name: nsLookup_nsAll
pretty: ⊢ ∀env x P v. nsAll P env ∧ nsLookup env x = SOME v ⇒ P x v

name: nsLookup_namespaceSET3
pretty: ⊢ ∀ns id v. nsLookup ns id = SOME v ⇒ v ∈ namespaceSET3 ns

name: nsLookup_FOLDR_nsLift_some
pretty:
⊢ ∀e p id v.
    nsLookup (FOLDR nsLift e p) id = SOME v ⇔
    p = [] ∧ nsLookup e id = SOME v ∨ p ≠ [] ∧ ∃p2 n. id = mk_id (p ++ p2) n ∧ nsLookup e (mk_id p2 n) = SOME v

name: nsLookup_FOLDR_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀e p k. nsLookup (FOLDR nsLift e p) (mk_id p k) = nsLookup e (Short k)

name: nsLookup_Bind_v_some
pretty: ⊢ nsLookup (Bind v []) k = SOME x ⇔ ∃y. k = Short y ∧ ALOOKUP v y = SOME x

name: nsLookup_alist_to_ns_some
pretty: ⊢ ∀l id v. nsLookup (alist_to_ns l) id = SOME v ⇔ ∃x'. id = Short x' ∧ ALOOKUP l x' = SOME v

name: nsLookup_alist_to_ns_none
pretty: ⊢ ∀l id. nsLookup (alist_to_ns l) id = NONE ⇔ ∀x'. id = Short x' ⇒ ALOOKUP l x' = NONE

name: nsLookup_after_nsOpen
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path env = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookup opened id = nsLookup env (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id))

name: nsLookup_after_nsLookupMod
pretty:
⊢ ∀env path opened id.
    nsLookupMod env path = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookup env (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id)) = nsLookup opened id

name: nsLift_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀f n mn. nsLift mn (nsMap f n) = nsMap f (nsLift mn n)

name: nsDomMod_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsDomMod (nsSing x y) = {[]}

name: nsDomMod_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn n. nsDomMod (nsLift mn n) = [] INSERT IMAGE (CONS mn) (nsDomMod n)

name: nsDomMod_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ nsDomMod nsEmpty = {[]}

name: nsDomMod_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y n. nsDomMod (nsBind x y n) = nsDomMod n

name: nsDomMod_nsAppend_flat
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2. nsDomMod n1 = {[]} ⇒ nsDomMod (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDomMod n2

name: nsDomMod_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀l. nsDomMod (alist_to_ns l) = {[]}

name: nsDom_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsDom (nsSing x y) = {Short x}

name: nsDom_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn n. nsDom (nsLift mn n) = IMAGE (Long mn) (nsDom n)

name: nsDom_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ nsDom nsEmpty = ∅

name: nsDom_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y n. nsDom (nsBind x y n) = Short x INSERT nsDom n

name: nsDom_nsAppend_flat
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2. nsDomMod n1 = {[]} ⇒ nsDom (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDom n1 ∪ nsDom n2

name: nsDom_nsAppend_equal
pretty:
⊢ ∀n1 n2 n3 n4.
    nsDom n1 = nsDom n3 ∧ nsDom n2 = nsDom n4 ∧ nsDomMod n1 = nsDomMod n3 ∧ nsDomMod n2 = nsDomMod n4 ⇒
    nsDom (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDom (nsAppend n3 n4) ∧ nsDomMod (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDomMod (nsAppend n3 n4)

name: nsDom_nsAppend_alist
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsDom (nsAppend (alist_to_ns x) y) = set (MAP (Short ∘ FST) x) ∪ nsDom y

name: nsDom_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀l. nsDom (alist_to_ns l) = set (MAP (Short ∘ FST) l)

name: nsBindList_short_lookup
pretty:
⊢ ∀bindings name env.
    nsLookup (nsBindList bindings env) (Short name) =
    case ALOOKUP bindings name of NONE => nsLookup env (Short name) | SOME v => SOME v

name: nsBindList_long_lookup
pretty: ⊢ ∀bindings env m name. nsLookup (nsBindList bindings env) (Long m name) = nsLookup env (Long m name)

name: nsBindList_LIST_REL_lookup
pretty:
⊢ ∀bindings bindings' env env' id.
    LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (y,w). x = y ∧ R v w) bindings bindings' ∧ OPTREL R (nsLookup env id) (nsLookup env' id) ⇒
    OPTREL R (nsLookup (nsBindList bindings env) id) (nsLookup (nsBindList bindings' env') id)

name: nsBindList_global_bind_commute_lookup
pretty:
⊢ ALOOKUP locals fresh = NONE ⇒
  nsLookup (nsBindList locals (nsBind fresh value globals)) id =
  nsLookup (nsBind fresh value (nsBindList locals globals)) id

name: nsBindList_clauses
pretty: ⊢ nsBindList [] env = env ∧ nsBindList ((name,value)::bindings) env = nsBind name value (nsBindList bindings env)

name: nsBindList_append
pretty: ⊢ nsBindList (bindings ++ locals) env = nsBindList bindings (nsBindList locals env)

name: nsBind_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y env. nsBind x y env ≠ nsEmpty

name: nsBind_11
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y n x' y' n'. nsBind x y n = nsBind x' y' n' ⇔ x = x' ∧ y = y' ∧ n = n'

name: nsAppend_to_nsBindList
pretty: ⊢ ∀l. nsAppend (alist_to_ns l) e = nsBindList l e

name: nsAppend_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x e. nsAppend (nsSing n x) e = nsBind n x e

name: nsAppend_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀env. nsAppend env nsEmpty = env ∧ nsAppend nsEmpty env = env

name: nsAppend_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀k v e1 e2. nsAppend (nsBind k v e1) e2 = nsBind k v (nsAppend e1 e2)

name: nsAppend_assoc
pretty: ⊢ ∀e1 e2 e3. nsAppend e1 (nsAppend e2 e3) = nsAppend (nsAppend e1 e2) e3

name: nsAppend_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀al1 al2. nsAppend (alist_to_ns al1) (alist_to_ns al2) = alist_to_ns (al1 ++ al2)

name: nsAll_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀R n v. nsAll R (nsSing n v) ⇔ R (Short n) v

name: nsAll_nsOptBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P x v e. (x = NONE ∨ ∃n. x = SOME n ∧ P (Short n) v) ∧ nsAll P e ⇒ nsAll P (nsOptBind x v e)

name: nsAll_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀f n P. nsAll P (nsMap f n) ⇔ nsAll (λx y. P x (f y)) n

name: nsAll_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀R mn e. nsAll R (nsLift mn e) ⇔ nsAll (λid. R (Long mn id)) e

name: nsAll_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀f. nsAll f nsEmpty

name: nsAll_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀P x v e. P (Short x) v ∧ nsAll P e ⇒ nsAll P (nsBind x v e)

name: nsAll_nsAppend_left
pretty: ⊢ ∀P n1 n2. nsAll P (nsAppend n1 n2) ⇒ nsAll P n1

name: nsAll_nsAppend
pretty: ⊢ ∀f e1 e2. nsAll f e1 ∧ nsAll f e2 ⇒ nsAll f (nsAppend e1 e2)

name: nsAll_mono
pretty: ⊢ (∀id x. P id x ⇒ Q id x) ⇒ nsAll P e ⇒ nsAll Q e

name: nsAll_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀R l. EVERY (λ(n,v). R (Short n) v) l ⇒ nsAll R (alist_to_ns l)

name: nsAll_after_nsOpen
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path env = SOME opened ∧ nsAll P env ⇒ nsAll (λid v. P (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id)) v) opened

name: nsAll_after_nsLookupMod
pretty:
⊢ nsLookupMod env path = SOME opened ∧ nsAll P env ⇒
  nsAll (λid v. P (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id)) v) opened

name: nsAll2_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀R n1 v1 n2 v2. nsAll2 R (nsSing n1 v1) (nsSing n2 v2) ⇔ n1 = n2 ∧ R (Short n1) v1 v2

name: nsAll2_nsLookup_none
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e2 n. nsAll2 R e1 e2 ⇒ (nsLookup e1 n = NONE ⇔ nsLookup e2 n = NONE)

name: nsAll2_nsLookup2
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e2 n v2. nsLookup e2 n = SOME v2 ∧ nsAll2 R e1 e2 ⇒ ∃v1. nsLookup e1 n = SOME v1 ∧ R n v1 v2

name: nsAll2_nsLookup1
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e2 n v1. nsLookup e1 n = SOME v1 ∧ nsAll2 R e1 e2 ⇒ ∃v2. nsLookup e2 n = SOME v2 ∧ R n v1 v2

name: nsAll2_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀R mn e1 e2. nsAll2 R (nsLift mn e1) (nsLift mn e2) ⇔ nsAll2 (λid. R (Long mn id)) e1 e2

name: nsAll2_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀f. nsAll2 f nsEmpty nsEmpty

name: nsAll2_nsBindList
pretty:
⊢ ∀R l1 l2 e1 e2.
    LIST_REL (λ(x,y) (x',y'). x = x' ∧ R (Short x) y y') l1 l2 ∧ nsAll2 R e1 e2 ⇒
    nsAll2 R (nsBindList l1 e1) (nsBindList l2 e2)

name: nsAll2_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀R x v1 v2 e1 e2. R (Short x) v1 v2 ∧ nsAll2 R e1 e2 ⇒ nsAll2 R (nsBind x v1 e1) (nsBind x v2 e2)

name: nsAll2_nsAppend
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e1' e2 e2'. nsAll2 R e1 e2 ∧ nsAll2 R e1' e2' ⇒ nsAll2 R (nsAppend e1 e1') (nsAppend e2 e2')

name: nsAll2_mono
pretty: ⊢ (∀x y z. R1 x y z ⇒ R2 x y z) ⇒ nsAll2 R1 e1 e2 ⇒ nsAll2 R2 e1 e2

name: nsAll2_flip
pretty: ⊢ nsAll2 R env1 env2 ⇒ nsAll2 (λid y x. R id x y) env2 env1

name: nsAll2_conj
pretty: ⊢ ∀P Q e1 e2. nsAll2 (λid x y. P id x y ∧ Q id x y) e1 e2 ⇔ nsAll2 P e1 e2 ∧ nsAll2 Q e1 e2

name: nsAll2_before_nsOpen
pretty:
⊢ nsAll2 R env1 env2 ∧ nsOpen path env2 = SOME opened2 ⇒
  ∃opened1.
    nsOpen path env1 = SOME opened1 ∧ nsAll2 (λid. R (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id))) opened1 opened2

name: nsAll2_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀R l1 l2. LIST_REL (λ(x,y) (x',y'). x = x' ∧ R (Short x) y y') l1 l2 ⇒ nsAll2 R (alist_to_ns l1) (alist_to_ns l2)

name: nsAll2_after_nsOpen
pretty:
⊢ nsAll2 R env1 env2 ∧ nsOpen path env1 = SOME opened1 ⇒
  ∃opened2.
    nsOpen path env2 = SOME opened2 ∧ nsAll2 (λid. R (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id))) opened1 opened2

name: namespace_lookup_self_rel
pretty:
⊢ EVERY (λentry. R (SND entry) (SND entry)) bindings ∧
  EVERY (λentry. ∀id. OPTREL R (nsLookup (SND entry) id) (nsLookup (SND entry) id)) modules ⇒
  ∀id. OPTREL R (nsLookup (Bind bindings modules) id) (nsLookup (Bind bindings modules) id)

name: mk_id_thm
pretty: ⊢ ∀id. mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id

name: mk_id_surj
pretty: ⊢ ∀id. ∃p n. id = mk_id p n

name: mk_id_11
pretty: ⊢ ∀a b c d. mk_id a b = mk_id c d ⇔ a = c ∧ b = d

name: id_to_namemods_mk_id
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn x. id_to_n (mk_id mn x) = x

name: id_to_mods_mk_id
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn x. id_to_mods (mk_id mn x) = mn

name: eALL_T
pretty: ⊢ ∀e. nsAll (λn x. T) e

name: ALOOKUP_LIST_REL_OPTREL
pretty: ⊢ LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (y,w). x = y ∧ R v w) bindings bindings' ⇒ OPTREL R (ALOOKUP bindings name) (ALOOKUP bindings' name)

name: alistSub_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e2. alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)

name: alistSub_cong
pretty:
⊢ ∀l1 l2 l1' l2' R R'.
    l1 = l1' ∧ l2 = l2' ∧ (∀n x y. ALOOKUP l1' n = SOME x ∧ ALOOKUP l2' n = SOME y ⇒ (R n x y ⇔ R' n x y)) ⇒
    (alistSub R l1 l2 ⇔ alistSub R' l1' l2')

name: alist_to_ns_nil
pretty: ⊢ alist_to_ns [] = nsEmpty

name: alist_to_ns_cons
pretty: ⊢ ∀k v l. alist_to_ns ((k,v)::l) = nsBind k v (alist_to_ns l)

name: alist_to_ns_11
pretty: ⊢ ∀l1 l2. alist_to_ns l1 = alist_to_ns l2 ⇔ l1 = l2

name: alist_rel_restr_thm
pretty:
⊢ ∀R e1 e2 keys.
    alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 keys ⇔ ∀k. MEM k keys ⇒ ∃v1 v2. ALOOKUP e1 k = SOME v1 ∧ ALOOKUP e2 k = SOME v2 ∧ R k v1 v2

name: alist_rel_restr_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀R l1 l2. alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  ∀R l1 l2 k1 keys.
    alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
      NONE => F
    | SOME v1 => case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of NONE => F | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys
